subfiles.title: Department of State list of papers on vessel transactions for the Japanese merchant marine
subfiles.about: A three-page index summarizes papers concerning foreign vessels sold or proposed for sale to Japanese interests and associated questions of registry, scrapping, and U.S. policy.
subfiles.summary: Docket (1931-39) indexes Japanese ship acquisitions and registry transfers, Yamashita's proposed Lykes Brothers purchase, and three scrap-condition ships reportedly still running under new Japanese names.

interest: Shows 1930s Japanese merchant-ship purchases and registry transfers, including ships sold to be scrapped but reportedly still running.
